rows.name: Salt Project
rows.reason: Infrastructure Salt handles remote execution, configuration and orchestration, not UI-wireframe rendering. It differs from PlantUML Salt; name overlap supplies no usable wireframing relationship.

rows.name: WireDSL
rows.reason: The official site shows a declarative language containing screens, layout containers and UI controls, with a renderer producing wireframes. That directly matches the requested text-to-wireframe workflow.

rows.name: wiremd
rows.reason: Wiremd provides extended Markdown controls/layouts with watch/preview. Generic Markdown is insufficient; HTML output is allowed, not prohibited by comparison with hand-authoring. Installation, plugins and rendering remain untested.

rows.name: WireScript
rows.reason: WireScript provides Lisp-like S-expressions, reusable definitions and live previews for text wireframes. Rendering requires its tooling; the Obsidian plugin is currently described as coming soon.

rows.name: WireDSL
rows.reason: Defines UI screens and components in a compact declarative language and renders wireframes to SVG, PNG or PDF, directly matching the requested text-authoring workflow.

rows.name: Wiremark
rows.reason: Wiremark renders indented Markdown components into sketch SVG layouts. Its renderer/host adapter is required; ordinary Markdown does not render custom blocks. Exact pre-cutoff availability remains unestablished.

rows.name: WireDSL
rows.reason: Declarative screens/components provide text-to-wireframe previews and exports. Project/screen/container verbosity is a fit tradeoff, not requirement failure. Browser/export behavior documented, unexecuted; historical availability unverified.

rows.name: PlantUML Salt
rows.reason: PlantUML Salt converts terse controls/grid notation into schematic UI wireframes for Mermaid-like authoring. It does not produce production interfaces; its widget and grid notation must be learned.

rows.name: wiremark
rows.reason: Indented text wireframes support browser editing; Markdown embedding needs renderer/adapter. Homepage undated; 2026-11-17 update snippet postdates question, not proof of origin. Editor/integration untested.

rows.name: WireDSL
rows.reason: Text-based screens and layouts, browser preview, and SVG/PNG/PDF exports; more verbose than Salt for tiny forms. Current features and pre-cutoff availability lack independent runtime or date verification.

rows.name: PlantUML Salt
rows.reason: The official Salt documentation explicitly covers UI wireframing and demonstrates text syntax for controls and grid layouts. This is the PlantUML component that directly matches the requested markup-driven wireframing workflow.

rows.name: Mockdown (ASCII-to-HTML implementation)
rows.reason: Fixed-width symbols become HTML mockups of inputs/buttons/checkboxes/radios. Requires manual spacing and legacy PHP setup; repository is archived, and current runtime compatibility was not tested.

rows.name: Salt Project
rows.reason: Automates system configuration, remote execution and infrastructure orchestration; its documentation offers no UI wireframing language, despite sharing the Salt name.

rows.name: Wireloom
rows.reason: Wireloom converts indented text into self-contained, low-fidelity SVG wireframes for Markdown. Embedding exported SVG does not mean native source-language rendering; pre-cutoff availability remains unverified.

rows.name: PlantUML Salt
rows.reason: Provides dedicated text syntax for UI controls and automatic grid layouts, so forms and screen wireframes can be authored quickly without drawing each element.

rows.name: PlantUML Salt
rows.reason: PlantUML Salt documents compact controls/grid wireframes in Salt, not Mermaid syntax. Authoring-speed fit is unmeasured; documentation was inspected but rendering was not executed.
